title: America's Army Made Of Rubber Fooled The Nazis 🎈
caption:
True story. In WW2 a secret US unit called the Ghost Army used inflatable tanks, sound trucks and fake radio to fool the enemy. 🎈
Would you have fallen for a rubber tank? 👇
first_comment: The Nazis were beaten partly by balloons and speakers. Most underrated unit of WW2? 🎈👇
